# PNEUMA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 19
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic/Functional)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 18-19 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 19

---

**19:1** After Levi said this, they set out — announcing the good news, preaching.

---

**The Gospel according to Mary.**

---

*Translator's Note (PNEUMA):* The gospel ends on motion. Everything that has happened — the teaching about sin and matter, the vision of the soul's ascent, the conflict between Peter and Mary, Levi's defense — all of it resolves not in argument but in departure. The disciples go. That is the gospel's final word.
